predecessor.closed_direction: A standalone 1024-256-128 projection may not replace the already-strong frozen embedding.

adapter.initial_function: Exact frozen DINOv2 identity mapping at epoch 0.

loss.positive_rule: For each positive anchor, use its least-similar other physical-instance view.
loss.hierarchy: same physical door > same-scene different door > ordinary different-class instance
loss.self_limiting: Hinge terms stop producing gradients once their local margin is satisfied.

selection.candidate_epoch_zero: The exact frozen DINOv2 identity mapping is a valid candidate and prevents validation regression.
selection.split: Only the three manifest-frozen validation families may select an epoch.
selection.order: Lexicographically maximize validation ranking accuracy, positive-hard accuracy, hierarchy accuracy, mean positive-hard gap, mean hard-ordinary gap, then prefer the earliest epoch.
selection.final_heldout_access: Forbidden during training and epoch selection.

literature_motivation.name: EGA
literature_motivation.use: Zero-initialized residual mapping, local self-limiting triplet loss, and hypersphere projection preserve unseen-class geometry.

literature_motivation.name: AdapterTune
literature_motivation.use: A zero-initialized low-rank up-projection makes adaptation start exactly at the pretrained function.

gate.requirements: Validation ranking and positive-hard gap may not decrease, hard-ordinary gap must improve, and maximum validation cosine drift may not exceed 0.02.

next_action: Freeze one final heldout evaluation on the untouched eleventh-family proposal failure, fresh active-view family, and local Development family.
fallback_action: Retain raw DINOv2 and test a non-parametric foreground patch-memory mechanism; do not inspect final heldout families.
claim_boundary: This is post-V1 Development model selection on the same frozen train/validation split. Final heldout families remain untouched; portal ownership, access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, and safety remain unevaluated.
